basic_info.description: Perched atop a charming circa-1885 4-unit building, this exquisite 3BR + office, 2BA condo offers the perfect blend of historic character & modern convenience. Adjacent to the storied charm of Cottage Row, this top-floor residence is a true sanctuary in the heart of the city. Inside, soaring ceilings over 10', original moldings & gleaming hardwood floors evoke the elegance of a bygone era, while a flexible layout adapts to today's lifestyle. Sunlight pours through oversized windows, bathing each room in warmth & inviting serenity. Formal dining room, framed by French doors, opens to a private deck w/sweeping views of the lush Cottage Row mini-park & beyond to Sutro Toweran idyllic setting for morning coffee or evening gatherings. Bright, thoughtfully designed kitchen features a Sub-Zero refrigerator, gas range, glass-front cabinetry & a charming double Dutch door leading to the view deck, perfect for alfresco dining. Additional highlights include in-unit WD & a spacious, finished attican ideal home office or creative studio, w/generous storage & natural light. Water & garbage utilities are included. Leased parking options & multiple transportation routes are nearby, but w/a 100 Walk Score, vibrant boutiques & eateries of Fillmore St & Japantown are a short stroll away.
